title: Man dead and two under arrest after daylight shooting on suburban Sydney street
summary: Police say a man in his early 20s was found in Blacktown with gunshot wounds to his neck, chest and leg A man has died and two others are in custody after a daylight shooting on a suburban street in Sydney. Police were called to Carinya Street, Blacktown, at about 11.50am on Friday following reports of a public place shooting. Continue reading...
